issues.on_page: Statement of Cash Flows - Proprietary Funds, Total column (pp8-9): net cash from operating 25,083; capital and related financing (94,179); noncapital financing none; investing 0 (CDs (877) + interest 877); cash and cash equivalents beginning 554,804, end 485,708
issues.issue: The proprietary cash flow statement is printed, and it shows business-type cash at the start and end of the year, but proprietary is null. Business-type beginning cash 554,804 and ending cash 485,708 are recorded nowhere. Check: 554,804 + 25,083 - 94,179 + 0 = 485,708.

issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 511,606; County treasurer cash 4,024 (Total Governmental Funds)
issues.issue: ending_cash leaves out County treasurer cash 4,024, even though balance_sheet.assets[4] puts that line in Cash and Cash Equivalents. Under the user rule (county treasurer = Cash and Cash Equivalents), ending cash would be 515,630. Governmental beginning cash is not printed (no prior-year balance sheet), so null is correct.

The 'Rental and fees' detail lines (Rescue 17,927, Cedar Valley Center 2,360, Park 10,418) stay generic charges for services/fees, while the Pool line in the same schedule uses 'Recreation Fees'. The 2026-10-28 categories Ambulance Fees, Rentals and Recreation Fees would fit these departments, but the label is mixed ('Rental and fees'), so this is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Rental and fees 30,705; p16 Total column shows the same row by department: Rescue 17,927, Cedar Valley Center 2,360, Park 10,418
issues.issue: Mixed label kept as one line with category charges for services/fees. The department breakdown adds up exactly but does not split rentals from fees, so keeping one line is defensible.
